newsitem.title: UK: Centrica active on upbeat press report.
newsitem.headline: Centrica active on upbeat press report.

text.p: Shares in Centrica, the demerged British Gas supply business, were the most actively traded in London on Tuesday after a press report highlighted the company's performance in recent domestic competition trials.
The stock rose 1-1/2p to 90-1/4p in hefty trade of over nine million shares by 1025 GMT.
The Independent newspaper said Centrica had emerged as the surprise winner from the competition trials as the company had managed to off-load some of its least profitable customers.

Confidential industry research showed that Centrica managed to hold on to the bulk of its highest-spending households, whilst those tempted away were mostly the lower-spending households, the paper said.

"People had hoped that was exactly what would happen," said one senior trader. "It's not like shopping at a different supermarket, changing your gas supplier is not as practical and is not that cheap."
